narrative.northStar: The Classroom Door That Opens Itself
narrative.overview: SmartCheck should feel like walking through a door that opens as you arrive. It is quiet, clean and fast. At each moment it shows only the next thing to do. Students and teachers arrive at a screen, get its one job done, and leave. Nothing on the page competes with the job.
keyCharacteristics: One action color (Action Blue); status colors only for status.
White cards on a gray canvas, 22px corners, near-invisible shadow.
Thai-first typography; headline tracking tightened, body left at normal tracking.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Every tappable primary action is Action Blue. The legacy indigo (#4f46e5, --primary in style.css, the brand scale) is retired. Any screen still showing it is a bug to fix, not a second accent.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and rose appear only when they mean present, late or failed (or success, warning, error). Never use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Thai Line-Height Rule
rules.body: Never set Thai text below line-height 1.45, or upper vowels and tone marks collide with the line above.

rules.name: The Phone Floor Rule
rules.body: On student screens, any text a student must read to act is at least 0.875rem. This includes errors, the next step and status. Use 0.75rem only for meta that no one needs to act on.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Cards never get stronger shadows on hover. State is shown with color (blue wash, border) rather than lift.

dos: Do use Action Blue (#0071e3) for every primary action and nothing else.
Do keep every tappable control at least 44px tall, and a phone form's main action full width.
Do write every error as the fix, in Thai: what to turn on, where to stand, what to press.
Do keep Thai text at line-height 1.45 or more.
Do rebuild app/static/css/tailwind.css (npm run build in tools/tailwind) after adding a Tailwind class.
donts: Don't reintroduce the legacy indigo (#4f46e5) or a second accent color.
Don't use green, amber or rose for anything but attendance or result status.
Don't add hover lift or heavy shadows to cards.
Don't put text a student needs to act on below 0.875rem on student screens.
Don't change element ids used by checkin_flow.js, enrollment_v2.js or push_notifications.js while restyling.
